title: DME - MAINTENANCE PRACTICES
question: What are the specific steps involved in removing and reinstalling the KN-63 DME receiver to ensure proper electrical connections and secure attachment within the aircraft's avionics system?
answer: KN-63 DME Receiver Removal . (1) Set the MASTER and the AVIONICS switches to the off position. (2) Disengage the DME/ADF circuit breaker on the avionics circuit breaker panel. (3) Remove the right, aft cabin panel for access to the DME receiver unit. (4) Disconnect the electrical connector  from the receiver. (6) Remove the screws that attach the receiver to the support bracket. (7)  Remove the receiver from the airplane.KN-63 DME Receiver Installation . (1) Install the receiver with the connectors toward the front of the airplane. (2) Put the DME receiver in position. (3) Put the four screws through the receiver at the two holes in the front plate tab and the two slots in the rear plate tab. (4) Attach the receiver to the support bracket assembly with the screws. (5) Make sure that there is a correct electrical bond between the unit and the airplane structure. (6) Attach the electrical connector  to the DME receiver. (7)  Attach the electrical connector  to the DME receiver. (8) Install the right, aft cabin panel. (9) Set the MASTER and the AVIONICS switches to the ON position.  Engage the DME/ADF circuit breaker on the avionics circuit breaker panel.

question: How does the KN-63 DME display range, speed, and time-to-station information on an airplane equipped with Garmin G1000?

answer: KN-63 DME Receiver Removal . (1) Set the MASTER and the AVIONICS switches to the off position. (2) Disengage the DME/ADF circuit breaker on the avionics circuit breaker panel. (3) Remove the right, aft cabin panel for access to the DME receiver unit. (4) Disconnect the electrical connector  from the receiver. (6) Remove the screws that attach the receiver to the support bracket. (7)  Remove the receiver from the airplane.KN-63 DME Receiver Installation . (1) Install the receiver with the connectors toward the front of the airplane. (2) Put the DME receiver in position. (3) Put the four screws through the receiver at the two holes in the front plate tab and the two slots in the rear plate tab. (4) Attach the receiver to the support bracket assembly with the screws. (5) Make sure that there is a correct electrical bond between the unit and the airplane structure. (6) Attach the electrical connector  to the DME receiver. (7)  Attach the electrical connector  to the DME receiver. (8) Install the right, aft cabin panel. (9) Set the MASTER and the AVIONICS switches to the ON position.  Engage the DME/ADF circuit breaker on the avionics circuit breaker panel.

title: DME - MAINTENANCE PRACTICES
question: Where is the remote-mounted receiver for the KN-63 DME located on an airplane with Garmin G1000?
answer: On airplanes with Garmin G1000, the KN-63 distance measuring equipment  gives range, speed, and time-to-station information displayed through the G1000 display system. The KN-63 DME has a remote-mounted receiver in the rear fuselage at FS 172.10. The DME antenna is on the bottom fuselage below the cabin at FS 114.50.

title: DME - MAINTENANCE PRACTICES
question: What are the necessary steps to ensure proper electrical bonding when installing the DME antenna?
answer: DME Antenna Removal . (1) Set the MASTER and the AVIONICS switches to the off position. (2) Disengage the DME/ADF circuit breaker on the avionics circuit breaker panel. CAUTION: Be careful when you remove the nuts from the antenna.  The antenna can fall to the ground and as a result, be damaged. (3) Remove the nuts and the washers that attach the DME antenna to the airplane at FS 114.50. (4) Disconnect the electrical connector  from the antenna. (5) Remove the antenna from the airplane.DME Antenna Installation . (1) Solvent clean the surface of the airplane skin where you will install the antenna. (2) Put the antenna in position on the airplane skin. (3) Attach the antenna to the airplane skin with the nuts and the washers. (4) Make sure that there is a correct electrical bond between the antenna connector and the skin. (5) Connect the electrical connector  to the antenna. (6) Set the MASTER and the AVIONICS switches to the ON position. (7) Engage the DME/ADF circuit breaker on the avionics circuit breaker panel.
